Our story

From your Pinterest board to your wardrobe.

We all save the dreamy kurtis: the pastel florals, the soft chikankari, the sunlit, vintage-painting look that stays on our boards and never makes it to real life. Kurti Chronicles was started to change that.

We bring those Pinterest-worthy styles into the real world, turning inspiration into kurtis you can actually wear, with the same soft colors, delicate details and effortless drape, but made for everyday life, in comfortable fabrics and real sizes.

Our promise: every kurti tells a story, and we help you wear yours.
